plan.notes: Official SXU 'suggested four-year academic plan' (courses required in the major shown in bold on the source page). The page advises consulting an academic advisor before course selection. The plan page does not print a catalog year; catalog_year reflects the current 2026-2027 SXU Undergraduate Catalog the page is published under. Degree: BA (page states 120 credit hours required for the Bachelor of Arts). Semester rows as printed sum to 16/15/15/15/15/15/15/15 = 121 — plan transcribed exactly as published. The source varies capitalization ('Other Discipline with approval' / 'Other Discipline with Approval') and prints 'Elective of course for a minor' once; both normalized to the majority form, noted here. One of the natural science courses must have a lab component. Coursework in other disciplines includes business, communication sciences and disorders, nursing, communication, psychology, and international studies.
